Aeldari Vyper
Large Aeldari skimmer
AC 16 | HP 60 | DT 5 | Speed 90 ft | Handling +2
Crew 1 D, 1 G | Passengers 0 | Cargo 50 kg | Exceptional
Weapons: turret scatter laser (G); forward twin shuriken catapults (D). Exposed; low skimmer. Ignores ground-level 
difficult terrain and crosses calm water. Requires Aeldari operator or compatible interface; no Ogryn accommodation.
